title: PETER: Effects of postal and digital invitations and reminders on participation in colorectal cancer screening among young adults: A randomized controlled trial
summary: The PETER study aims to investigate the effect of a written invitation and reminder sent by post compared to a digital invitation and reminder sent by email on the uptake of colorectal cancer screening measures among young adults.
conditions: Malignant neoplasm of anus and anal canal
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
-  Individuals aged 40-49 at the planned start of their studies (Main study 45-49 years, explorative cohort 40,41).
- Contactable via paper-based mail or email (with a user account at BARMER).
Exclusion criteria:
- Established contact restriction 
- Previous colonoscopy  (EBM 13421, OPS 1-650)
- Stool test use in the past 12 months 
- Previous diagnosis of:
Crohn's disease (ICD-10: K50)
Ulcerative colitis (ICD-10: K51)
Colorectal Cancer (ICD-10: C18–C21)
- Previous invitation through the program (applies to exploratory cohort aged 40–41)
